info.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 25 at 7:04AM MDT until September 26 at 12:00PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
info.description:
...The National Weather Service in Albuquerque has issued a Flood Advisory for the following rivers in New Mexico...
Pecos River Below Acme affecting Chaves County.
.Heavy rains north of Acme will work through arroyos and creeks and lead to rises in the Pecos River at Acme to at least bankfull conditions.
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.
* WHERE...Pecos River below Acme.
* WHEN...From this morning to Saturday afternoon.
* IMPACTS...At 10.0 feet, left bank is approximately 10 ft above gage and subject to overflow At 13.0 feet, inundation of low laying areas including mostly range land.
* ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 6:45 AM MDT Friday the stage was 9.1 feet. - Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 12.9 feet this evening. - Action stage is 12.0 feet. - Flood stage is 13.0 feet. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
info.instruction:
Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.
If you are in the advisory area, remain alert to possible flooding or the possibility of the advisory being upgraded to a warning.
Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law enforcement and request they pass this information to the National Weather Service when you can do so safely.
Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/abq.
The next statement will be issued this evening at 900 PM MDT.

parameter.value: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM THIS MORNING TO SATURDAY AFTERNOON
